generationInputs.prompt: A dark green heart outline filled with colorful produce and grains alongside a stylized botanical design with colorful leaves and a curved line, all against a white background. The right side of the heart features four orange carrots with green leafy tops, a bunch of green broccoli, a red chili pepper, and four stalks of wheat with golden grains.
